instruction.text: The runway at an airport is 2723 `m` long. An average aeroplane needs 1311 `m` to take off. Work out how much of the runway is left unused.
instruction.sound: The runway at an airport is 2723 metres long. An average aeroplane needs 1,311 metres to take off. Work out how much of the runway is left unyoozed.

atoms.a: First, estimate the answer by rounding the lengths to the nearest hundreds.

instruction.text: Next, solve the calculation exactly using the column method.

instruction.text:
A Skies-1203 aeroplane can fly 9978 `km` with a full tank of fuel.
The flight from London to Kathmandu is 7327 `km`.
Work out how much further the aeroplane can fly once it has completed this trip.

instruction.text: The same Skies-1203 aeroplane can carry up to a 9500 `kg` load. On the flight from London to Kathmandu there are 82 passengers and crew who weigh 100 `kg` each including their luggage. Work out the weight remaining.
instruction.sound: The same Skies-1203 aeroplane can carry up to a 9500 kilogram load. On the flight from London to Kathmandu there are 82 passengers and crew who weigh 100 kg each including their luggage. Work out the weight remaining.

Next, calculate the remaining amount of weight the aeroplane can carry.
